Do not invent source reputation or source independence. Distinguish incompatible claims about the same referent from legitimate different referents, times and complementary answers. Match subject, relation direction, requested scope and answer type. Do not accept both mutually exclusive alternatives simply because both appear. Parametric memory is allowed but fallible: treat recalled facts as a separate prior, not certified evidence. Never claim external verification. Return only short answer strings in accepted_answers; explanations belong in explanation. Use [] if genuinely unresolved, but do not omit an answer solely to make the list short. Preserve all independently justified valid answers.
Temporarily set card suggestions aside and form a provisional answer from the question and full original paragraphs. Then inspect cards as possible reminders, not authoritative answer candidates. Admit a card suggestion only if its exact subject-relation-object assignment survives the conflicting evidence; quoting a false assertion does not establish truth. A discarded or empty previous draft may omit a valid answer: recover it from actual evidence, not from the desire to make the set larger. Prefer substantive contextual consistency over repetition, vivid prose or model agreement. Do not replace an already supported relation with a weaker incidental association. Return concise canonical names, one per distinct justified object, with one short explanation sentence.
